themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist in writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including their effectiveness, security implications, and impact on developer workflows.

themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Explores the use of autonomous AI agents that can perform research tasks, manage workflows, and interact in agent-to-agent scenarios.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist in various aspects of research, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial participants or data generated by AI to simulate real user behavior for research and testing.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as meeting notes, articles, and earnings calls, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating or enhancing the process of evaluating the usability of products and services.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers AI tools and methods for analyzing and understanding user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being applied to analyze qualitative data, such as interviews and open-ended responses, to extract insights.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Details how AI is used to gather, analyze, and leverage customer data and interactions to inform business decisions and product development.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Investigates the integration of AI into the design process, including AI-assisted design generation, UI/UX workflows, and design system development.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
